background: Royal Bank of Canada is Canada's largest bank and one of the largest in North America, funded by Canadian deposits and wholesale markets and lending on Canadian mortgages and to businesses, with large capital markets, wealth management and US operations through City National.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade on 27 Jan 2022. Capital ranks in the top quarter of Canadian banks, with CET1 of 13.5% and leverage of 4.3%. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 31 Jul 2026, and there has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
